reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her DM: send the truck to Bay 46. She told me herself on Oct 14 that she uses that bay for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Nettle project.

I also told her that if Thursday's pickup is for a different project, nothing she can see gives a bay for it, so she should check with that project's owner. Marcus and Dana each told me their own bays in their DMs, so I didn't share those. #north-team, which she's in, says nothing about Thornbury.
